notes.glitch-stutter: Composite: one blip from take 1 repeated 11 times, gaps shrinking 70 -> 18 ms into a buzz. Both takes repeated at a steady rate (55 and 75 ms).
notes.zoom-punch: Composite: take 1's thud (43-65 Hz, no click) raised an octave and saturated + take 2's first 45 ms (bright click). Take 1 had nothing above 200 Hz; take 2 was a bright hiss with no thud.
notes.notif-ping-1: Composite: take 1's glassy ping (~754 Hz) then the same ping a fourth up (~1007 Hz) 75 ms later. Both takes were a single note.
notes.notif-ping-2: Composite: the library's single marimba note as a falling E6-C6 tick-tock, 70 ms apart. Both takes were a muddy cluster (258-592 Hz).
notes.notif-ping-3: Take 1 as generated: a short round chat pop.
notes.phone-buzz: Composite: take 1's buzz (215 Hz + rattle) cut into two 0.2 s buzzes with a 0.12 s gap. Both takes buzzed once, continuously.
notes.keyboard-burst: Composite: both takes layered 30 ms apart; each had about 10-12 keystrokes a second against the brief's ~20.
notes.notif-swarm: Composite: 33 pings, chimes and buzzes from this set's takes, ever denser (3 -> 24 a second) and louder (-14 -> 0 dB) over 3 s, detuned and panned. Both takes started loud and decayed.
notes.sub-drone: Composite: take 2 (C2 drone with harmonics to ~500 Hz) extended by a phase-aligned loop, varispeed so the pitch rises 2 semitones over 8 s (65 -> 73.5 Hz), hard stop at 8.0 s. Take 1 sat at ~28 Hz and drifted down; take 2 was static and faded out.
notes.static-burst: Take 2 with a +8 dB high shelf at 3 kHz: both takes were mid-band crackle (centroid ~2.5 kHz), not white-noise hiss.
notes.riser-digital: Take 2, the last 2.0 s, so the file ends on its top (loudest and brightest), cut with a 4 ms fade. Take 1 dipped mid-way and faded out.
notes.barrage-cold-hit: Take 1 with a 30 Hz high-pass (its sub sat at 22-43 Hz) and cut at 0.5 s with a 60 ms fade, so it stops short.
notes.sub-drop: Take 1 (pitch falls 65 -> 22 Hz) with an 0.8 s fade-out and light saturation, so it fades as asked and reads on small speakers.
notes.shutter-snap: Take 1, started on its first strong click (clicks at ~5, 65, 120 and 165 ms).
notes.news-murmur: Take 1. Scribe speech-to-text found no words in it (empty transcript); the spectrum is voice-band, 200 Hz-2 kHz.
notes.reveal-boom-1: Retake (take 1 was a pure 43-65 Hz boom with no shimmer): punchy attack, 43 Hz boom ~0.45 s, then a bright ~9.6 kHz shimmer ringing from 0.5 s. 30 Hz high-pass, light saturation, 0.3 s tail fade.
notes.reveal-boom-2: Retake (take 1 was a pure sub boom): attack and a 43 Hz boom ~0.4 s, then a longer, slower bright shimmer (7-11.7 kHz) from 0.6 s. 30 Hz high-pass, light saturation, 0.3 s tail fade.
notes.crt-off: Take 1: a brief 12-13.4 kHz whine into a bright pop at 60-100 ms, then a 54-108 Hz collapse hum decaying. 40 Hz high-pass removes a 22 Hz rumble.
notes.suck-in: Take 1 (rises -65 -> 0 dB, centroid 2.7 -> 11.4 kHz), cut at 0.43 s where it is still within 1 dB of its peak, 4 ms fade: it stops dead on its loudest point. peakSec = its end.
